premises.text: Local businesses leave spend on the table because punch cards and check-in apps are high-friction and not personalized
premises.evidence_span: 85% of their customers are not meeting their maximum potential and spending as much as they could at that store

premises.text: Cardify awards personalized VIP points/rewards when customers simply swipe their existing credit cards—no NFC or phone at register
premises.evidence_span: I get points at these local places by simply swiping my credit card

premises.text: Businesses can offer tailored perks, competitions, and redemptions with zero software/hardware integration
premises.evidence_span: there is zero software integration, zero hardware integration for the business

premises.text: Real-time presence CRM shows who is in-store with spend and social context plus bottom-line insights
premises.evidence_span: Cardify, in real time, will show Fig & Olive who is at their store right now

premises.text: Distribution via Citigrid Media and Urban Spoon reaches ~half a million US merchants
premises.evidence_span: Cardify has a partnership with Citigrid Media and with Urban Spoon, which gets us to about half a million merchants across the US

value.text: Customers get tailored VIP perks effortlessly; local businesses recognize and engage customers and grow spend
value.evidence_span: get VIP rewards and perks at your favorite places that are custom-tailored towards you

causal_links.evidence_span: none of these solutions are personalized for me
I simply do what I normally do. I pay. And I instantly get points in Cardify
this is pretty much your next generation's CRM system for local businesses
the most disruptive products without distribution is nothing
